retained_foundations.locator: Borel, Automorphic forms on reductive groups, sections6.5,8.4,10 (printed subparagraphs8.5–8.6), pages17,23,27–28
retained_foundations.statement: Admissibility and finite dimensionality of automorphic forms of fixed finite compact type and finite-codimensional central ideal, including compact-finite vectors of irreducible L2 submodules. Exact finite multiplicity application proved in RFD1.

Haar/Fubini/Riesz theory, finite Hilbert tensor products, commutants, compact-open subgroups and bounded unitary intertwiners. All representation-specific and operator-normalization deductions are proved in the chapter.
Only RFD9 retains the common X, its ties, original gap and arithmetic counting producer required by ARO; these are not hypotheses of the full RFD8 theorem.
